scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “The Gaussian propeller bound in every dimension” (preprints/The-Gaussian-Propeller-Bound-in-Every-Dimension-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 096 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b546ae5fd2ea7011), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all positive integers d and k, every measurable partition (A1, . . . , Ak) of Rd satisfies k X i=1 Z Ai x dγd(x) 2 ≤ 9 8π . Empty cells are allowed. The constant is sharp whenever d ≥ 2 and k ≥ 3: three planar sectors of angle 2π/3, multiplied by the orthogonal complement of their plane, attain equality, with any further cells empty.
